name: maheidem-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins by maheidem - Windows-compatible versions and custom tools

plugins.name: obscura-browser
plugins.description: Stealth Obscura headless browser as a system-wide MCP (35 browser_* tools) that gets past Cloudflare. Bundles the Docker build (Obscura compiled --features stealth for real Chrome TLS/JA4), a supergateway HTTP gateway that injects server-level usage instructions, the /obscura:start command, and the driving-obscura skill.

plugins.name: interactive-cli
plugins.description: Drive any interactive, human-oriented CLI from Claude — spawn persistent sessions, send input, observe and stream output, wait for completion, and run end-to-end terminal tests. First skill: tmux-orchestrator (pure-CLI, no MCP dependency).

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Deep research agent with 5-phase workflow (SCOPE → SEARCH+CAPTURE → SYNTHESIZE → VALIDATE → HANDOFF), deterministic citation gate, dedup preflight, source-reliability rubric, and auto-maintained research index. Slash command /deep-research:research, agent-handoff protocol, validate-citations.sh + build-research-index.sh deterministic scripts, fixture test suite.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Standardized handoff documents for context preservation across agent / session boundaries. Ships the agent-handoff skill (write) and /handoff-resume command (read latest handoff after /clear).

plugins.name: pi-delegate
plugins.description: Delegate coding work to the locally-installed pi CLI (pi.dev's pi-coding-agent) so it runs on a local model. One RPC engine, two facades: a zero-dependency stdio MCP server (keep-alive conversations, mid-turn steering, elicitation) and the /pi-delegate:delegate command/subagent path.

plugins.name: orchestrator-mode
plugins.description: Per-project orchestrator mode with four states (off/on/pi/wf): the main conversation agent goes read-only (allowlist of read/search/delegation tools only; Write/Edit/Bash/NotebookEdit and all MCP tools blocked) while subagents keep full access. The 'pi' state additionally closes the general delegation escape hatch, allowing Task/Agent only to the pi-delegate plugin's subagent -- forcing all code changes through the local pi CLI. The 'wf' state closes delegation down to the Workflow tool: Task/Agent may spawn only the built-in read-only Explore scout, and all substantive delegation goes through Workflow (dynamic multi-agent workflows). SendMessage is allowed under 'pi' (Task/Agent gating means any target is necessarily a pi-delegate teammate), plus an audited set of non-mutating tools (Monitor, CronList, LSP, MCP resource-read tools, PushNotification, ScheduleWakeup). Any mode can carry a per-project --allowed-models restriction (family/substring model matching); when active, delegated Task/Agent calls and Workflow agent() calls must explicitly declare an allowed model -- omitting it is denied, not inherited. Bash/mcp__* calls whose tool_input references the state file are denied regardless of agent_id, and the main-thread toggle write now falls through to the normal permission prompt instead of auto-approving. The PI reminder now nudges the main thread to decompose substantial delegated work into small, independently-verifiable steps dispatched sequentially, rather than one large task, since pi is often a smaller/local model. OFF by default, opt-in per project via a root .orchestrator-mode.state file. Injects a mode-specific reminder into the main thread when active.

plugins.name: shepherd
plugins.description: Start a recurring 10-minute shepherd loop over a goal: invokes the built-in loop skill with a shepherd-role prompt (watch, act, unblock, understand problems) so the goal keeps running unattended. Fixed 10-minute cadence, session-only (backed by the loop skill's CronCreate scheduling, auto-expires per that tool's behavior).
